name: Levison Enterprises
old_description: When your industrial electronics, devices, or power supplies fail, you need to find an electronics repair solution quickly. Levison Enterprises specializes in electronic repair services tailored to fix current and legacy electronic projects and keep your operations running smoothly. Even when original PCB or Gerber files are unavailable, our experienced engineering team can diagnose and repair issues.
about:
Levison Enterprises operates from a 15,000-square-foot facility in Millbury, Ohio, where it has been based since 2014. The company traces its roots to an AC plasma display manufacturer that evolved into a full-service electronic contract manufacturer as printed-circuit-board technology advanced. President David M. Levison leads the privately held business, which emphasizes a culture of continuous improvement and customer partnership.

The shop provides design-to-build and build-to-print services spanning PCB assembly, cable and wire-harness fabrication, electronic repair and diagnostics, PCB design and engineering, rapid prototyping, and legacy-product reverse engineering. Its ESD-safe epoxy-coated production floor supports medical-device, aerospace, defense, food-safety, and industrial electronics programs. On-site engineers collaborate with clients from concept through supply-chain management and final test, and the company maintains a vetted supply chain with counterfeit-part mitigation.

Levison serves military and aerospace contractors (AS9100), medical-device OEMs (ISO 13485), food-safety equipment makers, and commercial industrial clients. Case studies reference Seagate Mobile Security Solutions, sanitation-testing systems, and legacy displays dating to the 1960s. The firm is ITAR registered and pursuing CMMC compliance for defense work.

The company states its differentiators as a domestic turnkey model with single-point project management, on-site engineering for real-time problem solving, PFMEA-driven process controls, and a quality framework anchored by ISO 9001, AS9100, and ISO 13485 certifications from NSF-ISR. Leadership targets 100 percent quality, on-time delivery, and customer satisfaction.
